{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Organizing for universal rights to healthcare, childcare, and education is a strategic imperative for DSA.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Organizing working-class women in healthcare, childcare, and education is a strategic imperative for DSA.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Fighting right-wing attempts to control bodies and ban trans and reproductive healthcare is a strategic imperative for DSA.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Within DSA, an organizing culture that empowers women, trans, and non-binary comrades should be created.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA is building a socialist feminist society and organizing culture.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Capitalism is a global system.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA seeks to replace capitalism with an international, ecologically sustainable, socialist society.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"In the envisioned socialist society, goods will be produced and distributed democratically based on need.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"In the envisioned socialist society, security will be determined collectively.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Today, DSA must sow the seeds of a democratic socialist future by building relationships with leftist parties and mass organizations around the world.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA must build relationships with organizations fighting against authoritarianism, fascism and imperialism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"DSA must work to build a popular, anti-war movement to demand respect for the self-determination and human rights of people in other nations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Organizing among US workers who crossed borders as migrants and refugees is a strategic priority for DSA.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
